# pve_file (Resource)

Storage content volume/file: created empty or by name on a node's storage, attributes updated, deleted by volume id.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "pve_file" "example" {
filename = "CHANGE_ME"
node = "pve1"
size = "CHANGE_ME"
storage = "local"
vmid = 100
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `filename` (String) The name of the file to create.
- `node` (String) The cluster node name.
- `size` (String) Size in kilobyte (1024 bytes). Optional suffixes 'M' (megabyte, 1024K) and 'G' (gigabyte, 1024M)
- `storage` (String) The storage identifier.
- `vmid` (Number) Specify owner VM

### Optional

- `delay` (Number) Time to wait for the task to finish. We return 'null' if the task finish within that time.
- `format` (String) Format of the image. One of: `raw`, `qcow2`, `subvol`, `vmdk`.
- `notes` (String) The new notes.
- `protected` (Boolean) Protection status. Currently only supported for backups.
- `volume` (String) Volume identifier

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Opaque identifier: node/storage/volume (also the `terraform import` format).
- `path` (String) The Path
- `used` (Number) Used space. Please note that most storage plugins do not report anything useful here.
